purpose: Evidence for the project owner to sign off, or not, on twelve candidate events for Milestone 2 step 2 (batch 1 of ~4). Nothing here is an acceptance: each event stays quarantined, and no label is computed, until the corresponding attestations are added.
how_candidates_were_chosen: Batch 1 is the first 12 of the 46 surviving step-2 candidates by filing date (LOVE 2025-06-12 through ACHV 2025-08-07), per the ~4-batches-of-~11-12 pacing the owner confirmed in reports/m2-step2-corporate-action-scope-authorization-2026-09-28.json. dry_run.result: All 12 pending events ran with no attestations: every event quarantined on FIRST_PUBLIC_TIME_UNVERIFIED with no labels. All 12 showed all 21 sessions present and no zero-volume days.
